The PostgreSQL codebase is structured around distinct subsystems such as *parser*, *optimizer*, *executor*, *buffer manager*, etc., which follow well-defined interfaces for communication between them. The subsystem you’re focused on—**executor**—handles the actual runtime execution of queries by evaluating plans generated by other components.
